Pass handle: a profile link, @handle, username or ID. Price per successful call: Facebook, Instagram, Reddit, Rumble, TikTok, X, YouTube: 1 credit. cursor.description: next_cursor from this tool's previous result: the rest of a cut result. Send the same other arguments.

detail.description: concise (default) returns the fields that answer most questions, without bottom_post_id and platform_specific; full returns every field. Same price: ask for full in the first call when you need one of them.

handle.description: A profile link, @handle, username or ID.

max_age.description: Accept a cached response up to this many seconds old. Cache hits cost 0 credits. Omit to always fetch fresh.

max_credits.description: The most this request may be charged, in credits. platform.description: Optional with a profile link, which names it; needed with a bare username or ID.
